name: French Overseas Departments, Collectivities, Monaco and Corsica
description: Addresses in the overseas departments (971 to 976), the collectivities that have codes of their own (Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Saint-Barthélemy, Saint-Martin, Wallis-et-Futuna, French Polynesia, New Caledonia), Monaco, and Corsica's two departments. Original cases written for this corpus from La Poste's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the postcodes and communes are La Poste's base officielle (Licence Ouverte 2.0), the departments' codes and the collectivities INSEE's (Licence Ouverte 2.0).
